evidence.quote: + Don't delete any rule group rule from your web ACLs whose name starts with `ShieldMitigationRuleGroup`. If you do delete this rule group, you disable the protections provided by Shield Advanced automatic mitigation for every resource that's associated with the web ACL. Additionally, it can take Shield Advanced some time to receive notice of the change and to update its settings. During this time, the Shield Advanced console pages will provide incorrect information.
